lead_raw_text:
The structure of ScNi crystallizes in the cubic space group Pm-3m (No. 221), with a unit cell containing two atoms and two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Ni and Sc centers adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors each (6 Ni and 6 Sc), at a uniform distance of 2.6158 Å. This analysis identifies 12-vertex coordination polyhedra around each center atom, with corner-, edge-, and face-sharing observed among the Ni- and Sc-centered polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning both sites.
